# `aitbc energy suggest`

Suggest a hardware-based energy profile and market price. Probes the local node (nvidia-smi power limit = real GPU TBP, lscpu CPU model), sums the whole-node draw, applies the electricity tariff, and prints the resulting energy floor plus two price anchors: the cost-way anchor (floor + --margin-pct) and, for catalog GPUs, the compute- multiplier market suggestion (1 AIT = one reference compute-hour = EUR 0.25). The offer price above the floor is the owner's decision.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc energy suggest [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--gpu-model` | text | — | no | GPU model override (skips nvidia-smi detection) |
| `--tbp-watts` | integer | — | no | Explicit per-GPU board watts (highest precedence) |
| `--gpu-count` | integer | `1` | no | GPUs covered by one registered resource |
| `--node-gpu-count` | integer | — | no | Total GPUs in this node (platform draw is shared across them) |
| `--cpu-watts` | integer | — | no | CPU sustained watts override |
| `--platform-watts` | integer | — | no | Board/RAM/fans/storage overhead override in watts |
| `--region` | text | — | no | Region code for the tariff table (or SHOP_REGION env) |
| `--eur-per-kwh` | float | — | no | Electricity tariff in EUR/kWh (or ENERGY_EUR_PER_KWH env) |
| `--ait-per-eur` | float | — | no | AIT/EUR rate override (default: on-chain rate, else 4.0) |
| `--margin-pct` | float | `100.0` | no | Cost-plus anchor: energy floor plus this margin % (the cost-way price; the multiplier is the value-way one) |
| `--duration-seconds` | integer | `3600` | no | Floor horizon in seconds (default 1h) |
| `--resource-id` | text | — | no | Resource ID used in the printed registration command / --register |
| `--provider-address` | text | — | no | Provider wallet address (required for --register) |
| `--model-id` | text | — | no | Model ID for registration (default: detected model) |
| `--wallet` | text | — | no | Wallet name for signing (with --register) |
| `--wallet-path` | text | — | no | Direct wallet file path (with --register) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--register` | flag | `false` | no | Submit the on-chain energy profile registration |
| `--json-output` | flag | `false` | no | Output raw JSON |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc energy suggest
```
